error.message: The loop through MIX13, MIX3, PUMP14, KREA4, SCDS5, HTXR6, MIX7, EXTR8, SPLIT9, HTXR19, HTXR10, HTXR18, SCDS15, SCDS11, SPLIT16, HTXR12, HTXR17 did not converge: at iteration 5, Column SCDS5: the rigorous column did not converge. Tried: Newton from the sum-rates start (temperatures at the bubble points), steps of at most 20 K (12 iterations, 5963 ms: the residual fell only from 1.022 to 0.2834 in 12 iterations); Newton from the sum-rates start (temperatures from the energy balances), steps of at most 20 K (12 iterations, 8400 ms: the residual fell only from 110500000 to 867000 in 12 iterations); continuation in the relative volatilities (stopped at 0 % of the way, after 1 steps, 10391 ms); Newton resumed from where the sum-rates start (temperatures at the bubble points) stopped, without the early stop (100 iterations in all, 18964 ms: 88 iterations were not enough); Newton resumed from where the sum-rates start (temperatures from the energy balances) stopped, without the early stop (17 iterations in all, 901 ms: the Jacobian is singular); continuation in the relative volatilities, the mean weighted by the liquid (stopped at 0 % of the way, after 1 steps, 8044 ms). Last residuals: material 1358000 mol/s, equilibrium 1.06, energy 3548000000000 W, specifications 0. This does not show that the column has no solution: try other feeds (more liquid or less gas), more stages, other feed stages, or stage duties that remove the heat of absorption. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 0.26 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 1.48e-3. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S27, S7, S21, S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
